custom_apis.name: Create_Budget_Modification
custom_apis.notes: POST, OAuth2, All users, key-value {itemId, modType, amount, reason, reference, effectiveDate, track}. Creates the modification + two approval rows (VP/CFO to rbelliveau) + first email atomically.

custom_apis.name: Get_User_Access_Lean
custom_apis.notes: Enabled details verified in Creator Microservices on 2026-10-02; Land Master PRODUCTION, Default.getUserAccessLean, backend 9.33. Same OAuth2 and All users scope as existing full access API. Signed-in Production GET parity remains pending; function-editor Execute used Development data. Authenticated widget access calls omit the user argument/query_params/parameters/payload so Deluge uses authoritative zoho.loginuser; neither native email nor its local part reliably identifies the Creator username. Additive only; no widget caller adopted at this verification snapshot. All full-response flags/roster retained, proformaOwners omitted.

custom_apis.name: Get_User_Access_Lean_DEV
custom_apis.notes: Land Master DEVELOPMENT, Default.getUserAccessLeanDev; application/json Key and Value. Preserves the exact existing Development-only identity alias. Live full/lean comparison matched every 37 retained keys against full38 with only proformaOwners omitted; denied-response parity also passed. Existing full endpoints unchanged; no widget caller adopted yet.

custom_apis.name: Handle_Approval_Action
custom_apis.notes: POST, OAuth2, All users. Existing {budgetId,approvalId,approvalAction,approvalNote}; approvalAction Check returns a targeted JSON-string snapshot of the triggering budget track, immediate successor, email delivery stamp, parent track, and financial finalization. Repair makes one idempotent routing/email attempt after an approved row; no new Custom API registration is required.

custom_apis.name: Manage_Budget
custom_apis.notes: POST, OAuth2, All users, application/json key-value {budgetId, action:'archive'|'restore'|'delete', userAccessId}. Resolves zoho.loginuser, requires the matching User_Access ID, and enforces User_Access.Delete_Archive_Budgets. Delete removes the budget and its scoped approval, modification, item, category, month, attachment, and comment children after clearing import-item lookup links.

custom_apis.name: Modification_Admin
custom_apis.notes: POST, OAuth2, All users, key-value {action:'update'|'delete'|'repair', modificationId, budgetId, modType, amount, reason, reference, effectiveDate}. Admin edit/delete (delete cascades to the approval chain, recalcs Revised_Final) and orphan-chain repair. Bound to production Land Master.

custom_apis.name: Send_Modification_Email
custom_apis.notes: POST, OAuth2, All users, application/json key-value {modificationId, action:'created'|'approved'|'rejected'}. Created via Custom API builder bound to Land Master DEVELOPMENT environment; verify binding after production push.

custom_apis.name: Submit_Budget_Modification
custom_apis.notes: POST, OAuth2, All users, key-value {modificationId}. Promotes a Draft modification: builds the two-row chain if missing, marks Submitted, sends first email.

custom_apis.name: PF_Budget_Transfer_DEV
custom_apis.notes: POST, OAuth2, All users, application/json Key and Value; payload:string; Standard response. Land Master DEVELOPMENT. Dedicated capability/preview/apply endpoint; no PF Save dispatch. Production PF_Budget_Transfer must be configured after user publishes the new functions.
